caption: An old bulb in a ceiling fixture flashes bright for an instant and then goes dark for good.

sa.check: A ceiling fixture with a bulb, lit.
The bulb flashes bright for an instant.
The bulb stays dark for the rest of the clip.
The order is lit, flash, dark.

pc.expect: The flash is a single brief brightening and the bulb then goes dark and stays dark; it does not come back on however long the clip runs.
pc.fail: The bulb comes back on after going dark; or flickers between lit and dark repeatedly; or the flash lasts to the end of the clip; or the bulb dims slowly instead of flashing and going out.

pc.expect: One fixture with one bulb; the bulb stays in the fixture, dark rather than gone; the room's contents are the same before and after.
pc.fail: The bulb vanishes rather than going dark; or a second bulb appears; or the fixture moves along the ceiling; or furniture appears or vanishes between the lit and dark frames.

pc.expect: The room's light follows the bulb: it brightens at the flash and goes dim when the bulb dies, with whatever remains lit coming from windows or other sources present before.
pc.fail: The bulb goes dark while the room stays as bright; or the room darkens while the bulb still glows; or the room brightens as the bulb dies; or light stays pooled under the dark fixture.

pc.expect: The fixture hangs still through the flash; nothing in the room moves at the flash or the blackout.
pc.fail: The fixture swings at the flash; or the light switch on the wall moves by itself; or objects in the room shift at the moment the bulb dies.

pc.expect: The fixture and bulb keep their shapes; the bulb does not shatter into the room or melt.
pc.fail: The bulb explodes and fragments fly; or the fixture melts or changes shape; or the bulb turns into a different object; or the ceiling opens.

pc.expect: The fixture's design, the ceiling and the room's colours stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The fixture changes shape or colour; or the ceiling changes colour rather than brightness; or the walls change colour.

note: A faint glow fading in the filament after the flash is the expected look of a dying bulb and is not a violation.
